=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tstart "Warnsdorff tour from a1; each square shows its move number, rank 8 at the top\n"
global board ulong 64
global mdx long 8
global mdy long 8
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emitw writes n right-aligned in w columns (w at most 20; a wider number is not cut)
fn emitw n ulong w ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 32
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
if gt w sub 20 i
i = sub 20 w
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note target is the square a knight reaches from sq with move m, or 64 when it leaves the board
fn target sq ulong m ulong to ulong
f = add long rem sq 8 get mdx m
r = add long div sq 8 get mdy m
if or or lt f 0 gt f 7 or lt r 0 gt r 7
ret 64
end
ret ulong add mul r 8 f
end
note degree counts the unvisited squares reachable from sq
fn degree sq ulong to ulong
d = ulong 0
for m ulong 8
t = target sq m
if lt t 64
if eq get board t 0
d = add d 1
end
end
end
ret d
end
note Warnsdorff's rule: always move to the unvisited square with the fewest onward moves; ties go to
note the first in the move order (2,1) (1,2) (-1,2) (-2,1) (-2,-1) (-1,-2) (1,-2) (2,-1)
fn tour to bool
sq = ulong 0
put board 0 1
for k ulong 63
b = ulong 64
bd = ulong 9
for m ulong 8
t = target sq m
if lt t 64
if eq get board t 0
d = degree t
if lt d bd
b = t
bd = d
end
end
end
end
if eq b 64
ret false
end
put board b add k 2
sq = b
end
ret true
end
fn main to int
put mdx 0 2
put mdy 0 1
put mdx 1 1
put mdy 1 2
put mdx 2 -1
put mdy 2 2
put mdx 3 -2
put mdy 3 1
put mdx 4 -2
put mdy 4 -1
put mdx 5 -1
put mdy 5 -2
put mdx 6 1
put mdy 6 -2
put mdx 7 2
put mdy 7 -1
if not tour
exit 1
end
emit tstart
for x ulong 8
r = sub 7 x
for f ulong 8
emitw get board add mul r 8 f 3
end
emit nl
end
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
